Records.authors: Chestnov, Vsevolod, Crisanti, Giulio, Giroux, Mathieu
Records.description: Deformed acnode (Fig. 3(ii)): two-loop four-point diagram, K4-minus-one-edge topology (5 internal propagators, mass m1 on four edges and m2 on edge (2,3)), verified 2-loop via L = E - V + 1 = 5 - 4 + 1 = 2. Used to illustrate TWO distinct caveats: Type 1.2 (specialised higher-dimensional solution at the special locus l_degen = m1^2 - m2^2, i.e. specialising to equal masses reproduces the acnode of Fig. 3(i) exactly) and Type 2.2 (a FICTITIOUS singularity at l_spur = m1^2 s12 + m2^2 s23 + s12 s23, where the naive sector-by-sector count drops from 4 to 3 but the fully regulated Euler characteristic shows no genuine drop, chi=30 on both sides). master_integral_count=4 is the generic (non-degenerate) top-sector count quoted directly in the text; it is NOT the count at either special locus. EDGE LIST, VERTEX LABELS AND MASSES WERE SUPPLIED DIRECTLY BY THE USER, NOT EXTRACTED FROM PAPER TEXT: the arXiv LaTeX source shows this diagram only as a PDF figure (figures/diagram_acnode.pdf) with a descriptive label -- no propagator/graph data appears in the paper's text.
Records.location: Fig. 3(ii) (\cref{fig:app_diags}), Sec. "Subtleties with the Sectors Approach", Type 1.2 and Type 2.2 discussion
